headline: Pakistan Stock Exchange KSE-100 index falls below 178,000
summary: The Pakistan Stock Exchange (PSX) KSE-100 index closed below the 178,000 mark on Friday due to profit-taking and rising political tensions. Market sentiment was further pressured by concerns over oil supply following attacks on tankers in the Strait of Hormuz.
why: The KSE-100 is the benchmark index for the Pakistani equity market; its performance reflects investor confidence in the country's economic and political stability.

impacts.name: KSE-100
impacts.why: Index decline reflects broad market sell-off driven by political and supply concerns.
